Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. CXXXIX 46089 and synopsis 46092–46097 introduce Urbanus protocol 46099–46100. The curial decree 46113–46150 is explicitly inserted by 46110–46111 and confirmed by papal section 2 at 46152–46188; its signature is internal, not this act ending. Note 46141 belongs here; sections 2–3 and complete dating 46200–46204 close before CXL 46207.
